## Claim and source

Identify the file, proposition or theorem, and repository commit if known.

## Finding

Give the argument, counterexample, or missing implication. A partial finding
is welcome; state what you have and have not checked.

## Reproduction or proposed correction

Include exact parameters or a minimal command when relevant. Say whether the
finding affects a finite check, a conditional construction, or a machine bound.
